_comment: Copy to tools/apple_targets.json (gitignored) and fill in. ONE shared 'source' folder (where your sync client drops HAE JSON) fans out to EVERY target: each file is read once, sent to all targets, and cleaned up once (only after all succeed). The only secret is hec_token — the sync client (rclone/Dropbox/iCloud) owns cloud auth outside this file.

source._watch_dir_note: The local folder your sync client keeps current. Linux+rclone/Dropbox e.g. ~/hae_inbox or ~/Dropbox/Apps/Health Auto Export. Mac+iCloud e.g. ~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/HealthAutoExport.
source._archive_note: Set archive_dir to a LOCAL (non-cloud, non-repo) path to MOVE processed files there instead of deleting (safety window; prune it yourself). When set, it overrides delete_after_ingest.

personalWearables._skip_note: Empty = ingest everything (Apple-hub mode). Add any vendor you ALSO pull with its own TA (TA-oura/TA-withings) so Apple's thinner copy does not double-count; Apple still fills gaps (Apple Watch, iPhone, etc.).

cloudWearables._skip_note: Cloud also runs TA-oura/TA-garmin/TA-withings, so skip the vendors you push to Cloud directly (Apple relays Oura + Withings into HealthKit) to avoid double-counting. Use [] only if Cloud gets NO direct vendor data. Verify on Admin > Ingest & Data Quality > cross-pipeline double-representation. Cloud HEC = dedicated http-inputs host on :443, real cert (verify_ssl true), token scoped to index=wearables.
